text: じみちに　はたらくぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly talk that makes a firm statement, here a promise to himself. はたらくぞ = 'I'm going to work!'

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word turns it into the way something is done. じみちに = 'in a steady, honest way'.
